one_shot_rule: failure after the one-shot replay is final — no parameter tuning and re-reading. Insufficient future days (<180) report raw return only, not ann; <365 days cannot claim target hit.
rule: 2026-07-11+ is sealed until (a) 30 full calendar days elapse AND (b) selection is committed/pushed AND (c) future data has never been queried. Only then each selected row gets ONE replay. The validator records DB max timestamp and first future-query time.
